notes: SURNAME CORRECTED (research 2026-07-03): every primary-adjacent source found (NBGS Hierlihy file, PEI marriage register image, 1851/1861 New Brunswick censuses, per WikiTree Murray-2863) names this woman as Honoria HIERLIHY, daughter of Philip Hierlihy and Charlotte (Taylor) Hierlihy, later Mrs. Ephraim Gay (remarried 1822) — not 'Honoria Beatty.' No source found supports 'Beatty'; this looks like a conflation with the separate, well-documented Beattie/Beatty family of the same Tabusintac/Miramichi district, an easy mix-up given how many unrelated families intermarried in that small settlement.

BIRTH YEAR DISCREPANCY (research 2026-07-03, open question, unresolved): the dedicated Charlotte Taylor local-history site (charlottetaylor.ca), which documents her among the Hierlihy-Taylor children born at Miramichi, gives her birth as 1792, two years earlier than the tree's (and most online trees') 4 Mar 1794 — possibly a conflation with sister Charlotte Mary (b. 1794). Not resolved in this pass.
